title: Complete drafts without deriving profiles
description: Complete a calibration draft only as a resumable diagnostic record, explicitly refusing profile creation, correction derivation, and any prototype-derived tolerance or suitability decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Draft completion records reviewed diagnostics and completion metadata without creating a PrinterProfile
No prototype numeric threshold controls completion, evidence sufficiency, suitability, or confidence language
Completion UI states that observations remain unvalidated and PRD 26 physical gates remain unresolved
Repeated completion is idempotent and rejected premature completion preserves prior state

steps.details: Specify completion as closure of the draft workflow with reviewed diagnostics, not acceptance of physical evidence.
Validate only PRD 25 workflow prerequisites, emit no derivation effect, and preserve state on premature requests.
Show persistent text that no profile, correction, tolerance, suitability, or physical validation was produced.
Assert idempotence, premature refusal, no profile writes, no correction values, and absence of prototype threshold constants or claims.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement completion transition and boundary tests only.
Prototype commit 5f3f67b is feasibility evidence and must not supply production policy.
